parity.reason: 1/5. Comparator (WHO REACT prospective MA) used investigator-supplied 28-day mortality not in the trial publications. Re-tested at full text: only RECOVERY (pooled) has accessible 28-day all-cause mortality counts; the other trials full text is PUBLISHER-BLOCKED (PMC disallows XML download), and their CT.gov results post no mortality table. The reason is confirmed at full-text level, not just abstract.

refusals.verified: 28-day mortality 6/16 vs 2/14, exact counts in the committed abstract
refusals.not_pooled_because: n=30, stopped early; pooling it with RECOVERY's rate ratio produces a scale-mismatched IRR+OR combination and an uninformative interval (RR 1.30, 95% CI 0.0002-6827). Honest k=1 (RECOVERY) is preferred over an inflated, garbage k=2.

refusals.verified: 28-day mortality is reported in each trial's full text (CoDEX 85/151 vs 91/148; Metcovid 72/194 vs 76/199)
refusals.not_pooled_because: those counts are in the publisher full text (JAMA/OUP), not in our committed cached abstract, and the publisher pages are access-blocked, so the numbers cannot be self-verified against a committed source. Refused rather than pool on an unverifiable fetch.

refusals.verified: REMAP-CAP reports in-hospital mortality; CAPE-COVID reports day-21 mortality
refusals.not_pooled_because: neither reports the declared 28-day all-cause mortality in its publication; the comparator (WHO REACT) used investigator-supplied 28-day data not present in the papers.
